Frequently Asked Questions:
What If My Order Is Damaged?
Packages are occasionally damaged during shipping. If
your product arrives damaged please contact us and we will
arrange for replacement parts to be sent to you. Please
note that these parts can take up to two weeks to ship out to
you.

What if I Want to Return an Item?
If your item is not what you expected or is damaged, but
you do not want a replacement, eligible items can be
returned under our standard return policies and there will be
a link to Set up a Return next to the item details above. For
any additional questions about shipping, delivery, or returns,
click here for fast, personalized, help.
